findings: Wrong baseline avoided: reuse only exact four-pair D1S request/schema/route/reservation; synthetic 204-pair labels are test fixtures, not legal references.
Repair request content, including source/claims/candidates/pairs, is immutable; validator feedback and response schema are supplied on at most two further attempts.
Permanent dependency or budget limits stop dispatch; two consecutive transport failures stop the slice; exhausted tasks cannot become complete.
Interrupted work requires explicit recovery and counted attempts remain; exact response and append-only allowance receipts are rechecked before reuse.
Live relevance, fidelity and criticism preserve disagreements. Per-phase quotas sum to at most 169 of the additional 500; no timing ranking or production promotion is authorized.
Provider model/configuration route must match the retained source tasks; tests deliberately exercise bad routes, reservations, source mutation and missing pairs.
remaining_limits: Historical full matrix is frozen even if relevance proposals disagree
content.summary: The fixed checkpoint plan preserves the exact earlier 204-pair comparator, the 97-call history and source artifacts. New source and tests passed adversarial task-accounting checks before admission; engineering coverage does not certify English meaning.
